event_one_window.name: event_one_window
event_one_window.value: ("event"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "event"."ends_at" IS NOT NULL AND "event"."first_day" IS NULL AND "event"."last_day" IS NULL) OR ("event"."starts_at" IS NULL AND "event"."ends_at" IS NULL AND "event"."first_day" IS NOT NULL AND "event"."last_day" IS NOT NULL)

lesson_previous_only_when_changed.name: lesson_previous_only_when_changed
lesson_previous_only_when_changed.value: "lesson"."change" IS NOT NULL OR ("lesson"."previous_subject" IS NULL AND "lesson"."previous_room" IS NULL AND "lesson"."previous_teacher" IS NULL AND "lesson"."note" IS NULL)

lesson_text_length.name: lesson_text_length
lesson_text_length.value: char_length("lesson"."subject") <= 200 AND char_length("lesson"."room") <= 200 AND char_length("lesson"."teacher") <= 200 AND char_length("lesson"."previous_subject") <= 200 AND char_length("lesson"."previous_room") <= 200 AND char_length("lesson"."previous_teacher") <= 200 AND char_length("lesson"."note") <= 200

source_record_pending_idx.name: source_record_pending_idx
source_record_pending_idx.where: "source_record"."processed_at" IS NULL AND "source_record"."stated" IS NULL AND "source_record"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL AND "source_record"."purged_at" IS NULL

source_record_stated_is_no_message.name: source_record_stated_is_no_message
source_record_stated_is_no_message.value: "source_record"."stated" IS NULL OR ("source_record"."sender" IS NULL AND "source_record"."subject" IS NULL AND "source_record"."body" IS NULL AND "source_record"."purged_at" IS NULL AND "source_record"."occurred_at" IS NULL)

source_record_message_occurred.name: source_record_message_occurred
source_record_message_occurred.value: "source_record"."stated" IS NOT NULL OR "source_record"."occurred_at" IS NOT NULL

source_record_message_has_body.name: source_record_message_has_body
source_record_message_has_body.value: "source_record"."stated" IS NOT NULL OR ("source_record"."body" IS NULL) = ("source_record"."purged_at" IS NOT NULL)

source_record_purged_is_cleared.name: source_record_purged_is_cleared
source_record_purged_is_cleared.value: "source_record"."purged_at" IS NULL OR ("source_record"."sender" IS NULL AND "source_record"."subject" IS NULL AND "source_record"."body" IS NULL)

source_run_failure_complete.name: source_run_failure_complete
source_run_failure_complete.value: (("source_run"."failing_since" IS NULL) = ("source_run"."last_error_kind" IS NULL)) AND (("source_run"."failing_since" IS NULL) = ("source_run"."last_error" IS NULL))
